source: Frozen public candidate, independently compiled from source in each target release and tested with its pinned desktop dependencies.
test_services: Isolated HTTP model provider, separately issued HTTPS OAuth tokens and GNOME Secret Service. All service responses and resulting store changes were checked.
verified: Two configured models retained the previous conversation across a model switch. Provider credentials were retrieved from Secret Service and absent from the profile files.
History search returned the original text. Confirmed memories, named household subjects, local knowledge reindexing and scoped Skills controls operated on populated lists.
A locally installed Python extraction strategy compacted a real request. The next model request included the selected original passage verbatim.
Chat text was exported as Markdown and JSON. Reviewed JSON restored into a new ordinary chat. Cancelling cleanup preserved the reviewed chats; confirming removed them.
A single OAuth revocation changed access to the protected resource from HTTP 200 to 401 and removed its saved credential.
A cross-service batch received HTTP 503 for one service and HTTP 200 for another. The successful item was settled independently.
Retry from history and from the batch receipt reached only the failed service. After confirmation, its protected resource returned HTTP 401 and its credential was removed.
After reopening the store, read-only permission details displayed the failed and successful attempts, even while the client was busy. Tool receipts retained the selected operation and its timing.
additional_coverage: Released Catppuccin 0.2.6 with the actual Node runtime on Ubuntu 24.04: four themes, native selection, web preference callback, GTK color application and fallback after disable.
scope: Headless X11 and Wayland sessions on arm64.
Audio and video calls remain experimental and unfinished.
